component.name: LGo Download Manager
下载管理器
component.summary: Multi-protocol download manager with a native desktop UI

description.p: LGo Download Manager (lgdm) is a download manager for HTTP, HTTPS, FTP and WebDAV that splits each download into byte ranges and fetches them concurrently, so a single connection's throughput is no longer the ceiling.
下载管理器(lgdm)支持 HTTP / HTTPS / FTP / WebDAV,把每个任务切成 字节区间并发下载,不再受单连接速度限制。

ul.li: Resumable downloads: pausing and restarting continues from the bytes already fetched.
Per-task tuning: concurrency, chunk size, User-Agent, cookies, FTP mode, proxy.
Live progress per chunk, plus speed and ETA for every task.
System proxy detection, or a manual proxy with a bypass list.
Tasks and settings are persisted locally in SQLite.
Resident system tray: closing the window keeps downloads running.
Browser hand-off through the lgom:// URL scheme.
Interface available in Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), English, Japanese, German and Russian.

description.p: First tagged release: concurrent byte-range downloads over HTTP, HTTPS, FTP and WebDAV, SQLite-persisted task list, system tray, lgom:// URL protocol, and login auto-start.
